definitions.gloss: without difficulty; easily; with no trouble
definitions.explanation: Accomplishing something smoothly and without encountering significant obstacles. Implies the task was completed more easily than expected.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}に{難|なん}なく{合格|ごうかく}した。
examples.english: I passed the exam without difficulty.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{難|なん}なくその{問題|もんだい}を{解|と}いた。
examples.english: He solved the problem with no trouble.

examples.japanese: {入念|にゅうねん}な{準備|じゅんび}のおかげで、プレゼンテーションは{難|なん}なく{終|お}わった。
examples.english: Thanks to thorough preparation, the presentation went off without a hitch.

notes:
USAGE:
{難|なん}なく is formed from {難|なん} (difficulty) + なく (without). It modifies verbs of accomplishment and implies the result was smoother than might have been expected. It is neutral to slightly formal in register.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {難|なん}なく{合格|ごうかく}する (to pass without difficulty)
- {難|なん}なく{成功|せいこう}する (to succeed easily)
- {難|なん}なく{解決|かいけつ}する (to resolve without trouble)
- {難|なん}なくこなす (to handle with ease)
- {難|なん}なく{突破|とっぱ}する (to break through easily)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {難|なん}なく: without difficulty (implies overcoming a potential challenge)
- {簡単|かんたん}に: easily (straightforward, no nuance of challenge)
- {楽|らく}に: with ease, comfortably (emphasizes lack of effort)
